name: Four-game matched PPO reward timing ablation with TH17 stock potential
initialization: Frozen shared four-title visual CNN after 3000 matched high-rank SFT updates on 70,142 unique four-tick windows. Zero new critic.
controls: No geometry, aim, automatic shoot, automatic bomb, programmed movement route or Continue. Raw original 112x96 grayscale camera and preceding absolute-difference image. One categorical movement head and three independent focus, shot and bomb heads.
frozen: Four training credits per native game and difficulty, then twelve held pairs per native game and difficulty. Odd seeds are Hard; even seeds are Lunatic. All seeds are policy RNG only. Pair held arms on the same host and game build. Report all complete credits and technical attempts separately.
reward: TH10, TH12 and TH13 retain the previous validated native event rewards. TH17 uses -1 per lost life, +1 per genuine life gained, +2 on first native entry to each new stage, -0.03 only on same-life consumed Bomb stock, +0.001 per 60 previously unseen active native ticks if that clock is independently qualified. Without a qualified clock omit TH17 dense time reward from all arms, record that choice before the first TRAIN credit.
endpoints: Independent TH17 pairs by rank. Stage 2, pre-fatal Bomb stock, post-fatal stock, native first loss / Stage 1 ticks, effective casts. Both arms of each seed on the same physical host and instance.
exclusion: No held or engineering credit contributes gradients. Do not impute completed credits or promote an unqualified title. At most 3 stages in these original trial builds.
shaping: TH17 only. Phi(s)=0.03*(3*spare_lives+bombs) at each observed decision, zero at terminal. Add gamma*Phi(next)-Phi(current) to original reward. Incoming stock from the game is privileged feedback during learning only. No change to actor inputs or test controls. Both arms reuse the exact same 32 original TRAIN credits, zero-initialized SFT critic, PPO random seed and optimizer budget.
interpretation: The discounted shaping terms sum to the same negative starting potential in every TH17 credit. This tests redistribution of learning feedback across decisions. Eight TRAIN credits contained no life or Bomb fragment changes. Fragment acquisition thus cannot be attributed to this run.
